coverage_summary: Global scan covered energy/logistics, financing conditions, monetary-policy transmission, trade/capital access and industrial-market signals. The most material observed delta remained Saudi Gulf export adaptation via East-West/Red Sea and Sohar ship-to-ship operations, but current evidence does not yet establish durable demonstrated scale or a sufficiently changed structural condition versus the canonical Atlas to justify a new candidate. BOJ tightening, global fund-flow divergence and high sovereign yields were material market signals but did not independently change an Atlas structural mechanism. No canonical Atlas file was modified.
